steps.description: Design a bootstrap experiment to probe solution space rigidity using small feedforward networks. Define a class of analytic constraints (e.g., polynomial or trigonometric functions) with known solution space dimensionality. For increasing sample sizes w, train networks of varying hidden widths N_c on w constraints, then evaluate maximum absolute error on a held-out validation set of constraints. Record the minimum N_c achieving zero violation (max error ≤ 1e-3). Plot N_c(w) to determine if rigidity (bounded, non-growing N_c) is achieved or if the space is fat (N_c diverges or is unattainable). Use ReLU activation, standard normalization, and rigorous early stopping to ensure generalization is measured correctly.
